title: fix(components): element:definition-list, element:repeater and action:button publish their spec-declared inputs; types retires ActionGroup (objectui#11168 slice 2)
body:
Refs #11168

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — widening: `action:button.size` now publishes `default` and `icon` (the page validator refused both), and `element:definition-list.items` is no longer required; narrowing: `element:definition-list.columns` takes the NUMBERS `1` / `2` instead of the strings, `element:repeater.filter` / `.sort` declare `of: 'object'`, and the `@object-ui/types` `ActionGroup` interface is removed. The fixed group ships it as `minor` (the version-alignment rule in AGENTS.md); the break is stated in both changesets.

Slice 2 of objectui#11168, under objectui#11111 decision 3 = B (record `5902351047`): each key decided by its own measurement through the real `SchemaRenderer`, the real registry and the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 rows. Declare what the renderer honours; refuse or retire what it does not. The card stays open for slice 3; this PR lands with `Refs`.

## What each key measured, and what moved

All rendering rows mount the block the way a page does (real `SchemaRenderer`, real registry). "Validator" means `validateTree` over the manifest `manifestFromConfigs` builds from the whole registry, the JSX-page compiler's and the save gate's pair.

| Key | Measured at BASE `1ccb5ba7d` | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| `element:definition-list.columns` | `2` draws `sm:grid-cols-2`; `'2'` draws `grid-cols-1` (the renderer compares `props.columns === 2`). The spec refuses `'1'` / `'2'` (`invalid_value`). The published enum was the strings, so the validator raised `error:invalid-enum` on `columns: 2`, the value the designer writes, and passed `'2'`. | Narrowed: the enum members are the numbers 1 and 2 (`{ label, value }` form). The validator now accepts `2` and reports `'2'`. |
| `element:definition-list.items` (required flag) | Absent: the spec accepts it and the renderer shows "No details", but the validator raised `error:missing-required-prop`. | `required` dropped, declared `of: 'object'`. In scope as the same block's input; see "Bounded in-place fix" below. |
| `element:definition-list.items` (members) | `term` is the `dt`; `description` is shown as-is: string or number verbatim, object as JSON, omitted as an em dash. `label` / `value` items render a blank term and an em dash, and the spec refuses them (`unrecognized_keys` at `items.0`). | Member pin registered. |
| `element:repeater.fields` | A bare name and `{ field }` each print that field's value, in order, after the title; a missing field prints an em dash. A `{ field, label }` entry prints the value and never the label; the spec refuses it (`invalid_union` at `fields.0`). | Member pin registered. The description no longer advertises `label`, and the internal `RepeaterColumn` type drops it. No `of` (member union), recorded in `MULTI_KIND_MEMBER_CONTRACTS`. |
| `element:repeater.filter` | The rules reach `adapter.find` as `$filter`, member for member, with `{current_user_id}` / `{current_org_id}` in `value` resolved first; a token-free list arrives unchanged. The spec refuses the record form (`invalid_type` at `filter`). | Member pin registered, `of: 'object'`. The lowering to the server AST is the adapter's own contract, pinned in `@object-ui/data-objectstack`. |
| `element:repeater.sort` | The items reach `$orderby` unchanged and in order. The spec refuses a bare name as a member (`invalid_type` at `sort.0`). | Member pin registered, `of: 'object'`. |
| `action:button.size` | `default`, `sm`, `lg` and `icon` reach the Button primitive as-is; `md` draws the same classes as `default`, **by mapping** (`schema.size === 'md' ? 'default' : …`). The registration published `sm` / `md` / `lg`, so the validator raised `error:invalid-enum` on `default` and `icon`. The spec row declares all five. | Widened: publishes `default`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `icon`, with a description saying `md` renders as `default`. |
| `@object-ui/types` `ActionGroup` | Reachable from the package entry: the built `dist/index.d.ts` re-exports it from `./ui-action.js`. Zero importers: `git grep` over this repository and over `../objectstack` (the second has no `@object-ui/types` importer at all). Not the mirror of `action:group`. That is `ActionGroupBlockSchema` (spec row by reference). It disagreed with the row on six counts: required `name` (refused), required `label` and `actions` (optional), `visible` string-only, and no `location` / `variant` / `size`. | The whole interface is retired, with a tombstone naming the replacement. That covers the booked `name` and the five other divergences of a published type with zero consumers. |

## Bounded in-place fix: `element:definition-list.items` required

The claim books `columns` and the `items` member pin on this block, and not the `required` flag. The dispatch asked whether that flag is in this slice. All four in-place conditions hold, so it is fixed here:
1. Same defect class as this card: a published declaration disagreeing with the 17.5.0 row on a block this card owns.
2. Mechanical: drop `required: true`. The spec docblock names the shape.
3. The file is in this claim's surface (`data-list.tsx`).
4. Same gate family; it is pinned in the same new pin file, and no new gate is added.

Evidence is in the table above, and ablation E below. ⚠️ The seat may want the claim's file surface to name this key.

## Ablations

Predictions were written to a file before any run. Each leg went through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor had to hit, and the blob change was verified. Each leg had an outer `trap` restoring from `HEAD` by absolute path. Vitest aliases `@object-ui/*` to `src`, so no `dist/` sits between a mutation and its assertion. Every restore was proven: blob == HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` empty.

| Leg | Mutation | Predicted | Observed |

| A | `columns` enum back to the strings | 3 red: guard `element:definition-list declares no arm the spec refuses outright` + 2 pin rows | exactly those 3, `247 passed (250)`; blob `e54574ef408e` to `25d2c302c708` and back |
| B | delete the `$orderby` hand-off | 2 red: pin sort row + `data-list.sortKey-10664` SUBJECT | exactly those 2 of 22 |
| C | `$filter` gets the raw authored filter | 1 red: the context-token row | exactly that 1 of 20; the token-free control stayed green |
| D | `size` enum back to `sm` / `md` / `lg` | 2 red in the button pin file; guard green | exactly those 2, `283 passed (285)` |
| E | `items` required again | 1 red: the optional-`items` row | exactly that 1 of 20. ⚠️ First attempt was a no-op: the replacement contained the anchor, so the tool refused (anchor count 1 to 1) and restored without running. Re-anchored and re-run. |
| F | restore `ActionGroup` (interface + entry re-export) | `tsc` TS2578 on the 2 directive lines; vitest 2 red | `error TS2578: Unused '@ts-expect-error' directive` on exactly the two `@ts-expect-error` directives of `action-group-retired-11168.test.ts` (tsc exit 2), vitest 2 of 2 red |

## Gates and tests (head `19a44d591`)

Heavy runs went through objectstack `os-verify-lock.sh`. Exits were captured by redirect-then-`$?`. Each suite log's first line is `19a44d591`.

- **Build:** `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/components^...'` 7 of 7; `--filter='@object-ui/console^...'` 34 of 34. `@object-ui/types^...` is empty (no workspace deps), so `types` was built itself.
- **Type-check** (script name echoed in each log):
  - `@object-ui/components` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exit 0;
  - `@object-ui/console` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force`) exit 0;
  - `@object-ui/types` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exit 0.
  - `--listFilesOnly` lists both component pin files, the types pin and the guard in their projects.
- **Suites:**
  - `packages/components` 348 files in three batches: 155 passed; 96 passed and 1 skipped; 96 passed.
  - `packages/types` 302 passed (7604 tests).
  - `apps/console` 139 files in two batches: 70 passed, 69 passed.
  - Readers outside those packages (every test naming these blocks or `ActionGroup`, the `sdui-parser` suite, `schema-catalog` pageheader, react config-bag): 38 passed (991 tests).
  - Final union: guard + 3 pin files `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 307 passed (307)`.
- **`check:*`, all exit 0:**
  - changeset presence / no-major / fixed / overwrite / claims, and `pending-changeset-literals`;
  - `control-bytes`, `new-line-citations` (0 new), `test-path-roots`, `action-forward-parity`, `handler-key-reads`, `component-surface-parity`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`;
  - `readme-exports`, `unreferenced-sources`, `phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `esm-specifiers`;
  - `doc-snippets` (`698 of 698 block(s) judged, 0 failed`), `doc-types`, `doc-examples`;
  - `prompt-keys`, `installed-pin-claims`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `doc-example-readers`, `registry-bare-names`, `i18n-keys`.
  - ⚠️ On the first run `readme-exports` exited 1 and `doc-snippets` / `doc-examples` exited 2: unbuilt `cli` / `plugin-ai`, a prerequisite and not a verdict. They were green after the gate's own scoped `--build-filter` build.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 10 changed paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- **Lint, declared narrowing:** `eslint` (this repo's `lint` is `eslint .`) on the 8 touched TS files gave 0 errors and 28 warnings, 0 of them on an added line.
  - Population: `--print-config` returns a rule set for each file.
  - File count: 8, from `--format json`.
  - Invariance: `eslint.config.js` contains neither `project` nor `parserOptions` (controls: `rules` 13 hits, `typescript-eslint` 7), so it is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict in an untouched file.
- NOT MEASURED:
  - `check:sdui-registration-pins`: needs a console bundle, and the diff touches no `sideEffects` array.
  - `check:spec-floors`: the diff touches no `package.json`.
  - Repo-wide `pnpm test` / `lint` / `type-check`: CI's.

## Docs

No page in `content/docs/**`, no package README and nothing under `skills/**` documents these keys or `ActionGroup` (census: `git grep` for `definition-list`, `element:repeater` and `ActionGroup`). The `ButtonSchema` size row in `schema-reference.md` is the `button` node, not `action:button`. These blocks' authoring surface is the manifest built from the registrations changed here, so no document is made false. The two changesets carry the release text.

## Acceptance notes (noted, not filed)

- `@object-ui/types` `UIActionSchema.size` is typed `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`. Measured: `tsc` refuses `size: 'icon'` and `size: 'default'` (TS2322); the control `lg` is accepted. The `action:button` row declares all five. Same family as the `ActionGroup` booking (the types mirror of the 17.5.0 action rows). It was not fixed here because `UIActionSchema` is also the member type of the `action:group` / `action:menu` / `action:bar` lists, so widening it is not a mechanical, pinned shape. For the seat to book on this card or its family closer.
- Eleven pending changesets name a file this diff touches (`check:changeset-claims`, report-only). Each was read; none states a fact this diff moves.
